description: For each given node id, a changelog of non-empty diffs against prior runs of the same test scenario and environment, keyed by node id. Use before concluding whether a changed or drifted element is dynamic (recurring changes) versus a one-time real change — never guess this from a single run alone. An empty array for a node means no change was found across however much history was searched; that alone is not proof of anything either way. Each historic comparison is computed server-side, so this call can take up to ~20 seconds per comparison — do not abort early; if the call is interrupted or reports a still-computing comparison, call it again with the same arguments and the walk resumes from cache.

count.description: Target number of non-empty diffs to collect per node; defaults to 3

nodeIds.description: DOM node ids to check, from a prior eyes_inspect_dom or eyes_inspect_dom_diff result

sessionUrl.description: Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present)

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the step, as returned by eyes_inspect_steps

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_inspect_history
